newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends technical session slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends technical session slightly higher.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed slightly higher in quiet technical trade, with LIT America and Dean Witter featured sellers for the second day, traders said.
"As we got below $11.95 (per cwt) in the May, we hit sell stops," a trader said. "Witter and LIT were sellers but LIT turned buyer late."
Traders said volume was estimated at a light 800 lots. The market continues to wait for Colombia to purchase 140,000 tonnes of rice.
Fundamentally, rising river levels were beginning to concern some traders.
One floor source said the rising waters could impede movement of rice to mills, a near-term bearish factor with long-term bullish implications.
"The river is high, they can't load barges," the trader said. "Mills in the south need rice."
Rice futures closed seven cents higher to two cents lower, with March up one cent at $12.04 per cwt.
